events.title: Hormuz CLOSED Day 164 - 59 ships redirected, 3 disabled, 2 boarded, talks stalled
events.details: 59 commercial vessels redirected (up from 55 on Aug 11), 3 disabled, 2 boarded. 8 transits vs 73/day normal. Trump says semi-negotiating with Tehran. Iran demands: end blockade, compensation, relax sanctions, unfreeze assets. Brent surging 5%+. CentCom claims Strait open for neutral non-Iranian transit.

events.title: Ebola deaths top 2,000 - fastest-growing outbreak on record, second largest ever
events.details: Bundibugyo ebolavirus, no approved treatments. WHO declared PHEIC May 17. 2,000+ deaths, 4,449+ cases. 53 health zones affected. WHO says trajectory will eclipse 11,000-death record. MSF running PARTNERS clinical trial. Vaccine development racing.

events.title: US Treasury acutely dependent on hedge fund short-term funding at 100x leverage - crisis ingredients assembling
events.details: Telegraph (Aug 11): US Treasury dependent on short-term funding from hedge funds tapping .3T money market, some at 100x leverage. Fed financial stability report flagged hedge fund leverage as primary concern. Ingredients for US fiscal-financial crisis coming together. Regulatory oversight gaps widening.

events.title: US-Japan joint yen intervention unraveling - yen back to ~159 after Aug 5 intervention
events.details: Joint intervention Aug 5 (US sold euros, bought yen). Yen rallied to 155 then unwound to ~159. Japan holds .14T in US Treasuries. BofA expects 6% yen strengthening by year-end (to 149). BOJ at 1.00%, pressured to hike. Nervous wait for next BOJ decision. FIMA facility given new strategic value.

events.title: Fed hike probability 30% - Warsh signaling inflation without nuance, markets pricing September hike
events.details: Rates at 3.50-3.75%, 5th consecutive hold. Warsh emphasizing inflation without nuanced commentary, leading investors to conclude hike coming. CME FedWatch shows 30% hike probability. Treasury refunding this week. CBS says jobs report changed calculus - September hike less certain.

events.title: Gold above ,400 record territory - oil surges 5%+ as Hormuz talks stall
events.details: Gold ,400+ (RED threshold breach above ,500). Oil surging 5%+ on Hormuz stalemate. Brent under  but elevated. Iran maintaining conditions for Hormuz reopening. Safe-haven demand extreme amid multi-crisis convergence.

events.title: China races to solve  property time bomb as land leases expire - deflation fight faltering
events.details: property threat as land leases expire. Property bust spilling across borders. PIIE: current account balances increase 4pp of GDP within 5 years of bubble bursting. PBOC balancing yuan stability vs devaluation. Emergency response funds for floods/drought in 5 provinces.

events.title: Argentina country risk at 451bps - Brazil ambassador withdrawn, BCRA reform vote Aug 19
events.details: Argentina country risk 451bps, highest since June. Brazil withdrew ambassador. BCRA charter reform vote Aug 19 - Milei pushing to ban state financing. Peso decade-long destruction of purchasing power continues. US Treasury ESF .5B lifeline to Argentina noted.

events.title: ECB holds at 2.25% - July 23 decision unchanged, no emergency, unwinding QE
events.details: ECB cut 8 times Jun 2024-Jun 2025, then held. Now 2.25%. July 23 decision to keep rates unchanged. Financial conditions slightly tighter. Unwinding QE programmes. No emergency. OMFIF discussing fiscal-monetary council architecture.

events.title: UK gilt yields elevated - 10Y at 5.05%, 30Y at 5.7%, no acute crisis
events.details: 10Y gilt yields at 5.05%, 30Y at 5.7% (mid-Aug 2026). Additional £330M index-linked gilt 2035 created for Aug 13 settlement. OMFIF reflecting on 2022 gilt crisis precedent. No BoE emergency action. Gilts stable but elevated.

events.title: EM Asia currency defense - India rupee recovering from diaspora deposits, won leading declines
events.details: India lured  from diaspora via high-yield dollar deposits, rupee recovering from May record low. Korea won biggest monthly gain since 2022 but now leading declines. No acute crisis. Currency defense getting makeover as EM Asia guards reserves.

events.title: Nigeria alleged coup plot against Tinubu - South Africa anti-gang officers murdered
events.details: Nigeria: alleged failed coup plot against Tinubu reported. South Africa: two Anti-Gang Unit officers murdered in Reiger Park, acting top cop appeals to public. SARB warns of silent crisis. No new successful coups this period.

events.title: Regulatory oversight gaps widening - Russia bankruptcies rising, Senegal debt restructuring risk
events.source: American Banker/Moscow Times/Seeking Alpha/Bank Policy Institute
events.details: Federal regulatory bodies face sweeping workforce reductions. Novel payment models present unique failure modes. Russia bankruptcies rising. Senegal debt restructuring increasingly likely. BPI focused on AML/CFT for stablecoin ecosystem. No acute US bank failure.
